items.stem: Which campaign type is best matched to a top-of-funnel brand-awareness objective?

options.text: Search ads on exact-match transactional keywords
options.rationale: Exact-match search captures existing demand, not broad awareness.
Correct: video on YouTube is well suited to building awareness and reach.

options.text: Dynamic search ads for the whole site
options.rationale: Dynamic search still targets existing search demand, not awareness.
Call-only ads target high-intent response, not awareness.

items.explanation: Correct: video on YouTube is well suited to building awareness and reach.

items.stem: In Shopping campaigns, product performance depends heavily on:

options.text: Keyword bids only, as in search
options.rationale: Shopping has no keywords; it relies on the product feed and bids together.

options.text: The quality and relevance of the product feed data
options.rationale: Correct: accurate, optimised feed data drives when and how products show.

options.text: The colour of the landing page
options.rationale: Landing-page colour is not a core Shopping ranking factor.

options.text: The number of negative keywords alone
options.rationale: Negatives help, but feed quality is the central driver.

items.explanation: Correct: accurate, optimised feed data drives when and how products show.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Performance Max are accurate? (Select TWO)

options.text: It serves across multiple Google networks from one campaign using supplied assets
options.rationale: Correct: Performance Max spans Search, Display, YouTube and more from one campaign.

options.text: Strong asset groups and clear conversion goals materially affect its results
options.rationale: Correct: asset quality and well-defined goals drive Performance Max performance.

options.text: It requires no inputs and should never be monitored
options.rationale: It still needs quality assets, goals and ongoing oversight.

options.text: It only ever runs on the Search network
options.rationale: Performance Max is multi-network, not Search-only.

items.explanation: Correct: Performance Max spans Search, Display, YouTube and more from one campaign.; Correct: asset quality and well-defined goals drive Performance Max performance.
